name: list
gotchas: `mat-selection-list`/`mat-list-option` selection state needs to be read through `(selectionChange)` or the list's `selectedOptions` `SelectionModel` — binding `[selected]` on `mat-list-option` only sets the initial state, it doesn't itself notify you of subsequent user toggles.

`mat-nav-list` items are meant to be `<a mat-list-item>` anchors that handle their own navigation — using `<button mat-list-item>` inside a `mat-nav-list` still looks right but loses anchor-specific behavior (open in new tab, middle-click, etc.) that's the point of a nav list.

Multi-line list items require the exact `matListItemTitle`/`matListItemLine` structure — plain text nodes placed directly inside `mat-list-item` without these directives collapse to a single line and don't get the multi-line height/typography tokens.
